data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2012 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 17.365 million in 2015, representing a 7.31% release against opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by a reduction in the frequency and severity of risk loss activity experienced in prior years, contributing to an overall improvement in underwriting performance from prior accident years. No specific named events were cited as impacting prior year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: reduction in the frequency and severity of risk loss activity experienced in prior years
favourable development from prior accident years
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is taken from the 'Claims Provisions' reconciliation table, which directly states the movement per technical account. A calculation from the gross claims development triangle yields a significantly different figure (-148.778m), which is not used for the prior_year_development_gbp_m field as the reconciliation table is considered more authoritative for the total movement.
